evidence: Skill procedure (quality-checks.md:25-27): grep for judge|rubric|criteri|dimension|reward|weight|score.py|playwright|claude|glm|/tests|sentinel, plus long verbatim overlap. Running that grep (extended with grader|gate|probe|verifier|oracle|polish|visual|functional|harness|evaluat|checker|test) over task/instruction.md, all six environment/instructions/*.md and environment/assets/seed_data.json returned zero hits. A literal scan of every uppercase token, cw_* criterion id and quoted string in tests/** found only runtime-contract strings in the public text (/app/app.db, /app/server.js, DB_PATH, NODE_PATH from integration.md:3-9), which are legitimate product requirements, not grader machinery; no criterion id, probe literal or dimension name appears. A 10-word n-gram overlap scan between the public text and every tests/** file found no shared runs, so criteria are not copied verbatim. environment/Dockerfile:14-15 copies only instructions/ and assets/ into the agent image, so no test file is exposed. instruction.md's closing self-check request ('type into the editor, run the code and save a snippet') and behaviour.md's 'five-second run budget' are user-facing product language, not judge/test references. Counterfactuals: this row concerns the brief only; no broken app or conforming alternative changes the outcome because nothing in the brief tells an agent how it is graded. Static check; no runtime evidence is required for this row.
